import { Task, TaskStatus } from './Task';

export interface TaskRepository {
  save(task: Task): void;
  getById(id: string): Task | null;
  getByProjectId(projectId: string): Task[];
  getByProjectIdAndStatus(projectId: string, status: TaskStatus): Task[];
  getByProjectIdAndAssignee(projectId: string, assigneeId: string): Task[];
}
